summary: UCLA starts a backup quarterback making his first start, against a rested Wisconsin defense. The total has fallen to about 43, and Wisconsin has drawn most of the money.

legs.note: UCLA starts a first-time quarterback against a Wisconsin defense that allows 3.2 yards per rush and 16.6 points a game.
Both offenses run the ball and burn clock, and the under is 7-3 in Wisconsin's last 10 games.
Wisconsin has about 77% of the money, the line moved from 3 to 2.5, and UCLA is starting a first-time quarterback.
A first-time starter usually gets a conservative early game plan, and Wisconsin's first halves have been slow.

research:
1) QBs/personnel: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava (leg) is OUT; CBS says it is likely season-ending, while Chesney called it a 'serious concern'. He was 10/17 for 162 yards with 2 INT at Oregon before leaving. Starter Ty Dieffenbach (R-Jr, #14) redshirted twice at Pitt (2023-24) without a snap, then went 92/162 (56.8%) for 1,305 yds, 9 TD, 9 INT and a 131.7 rating, with 67 rushes for 321 yds and 4 TD, at FCS Cal Poly in 2025 (gopoly.com, Ourlads, UCLA roster). For UCLA he is 3/6 for 43 yds with 1 TD in relief. WIS QB Colton Joseph (ODU transfer; 2025 Sun Belt OPOY with 2,624 pass yds, 21 TD, 10 INT and 1,007 rush yds, 13 TD; career 5,383 pass yds, 42 TD, 1,916 rush yds, 27 TD) is 81/143 (56.6%) this year for 1,123-1,132 yds, 7.9 YPA, 10 TD, 5 INT, with 51 rushes for 262 yds and 3 TD (Wikipedia, StatSniper). He was 18/38 with 3 INT (1 pick-6) at PSU, threw for 362 yds and 3 TD vs EMU, and had 130 rush yds and 4 total TD vs MSU (AP, Bleacher Report).
2) Skill/injuries: UCLA RB Wayne Knight has 71 carries for 548 yds (7.7 YPC) and 11 TD (SI), including 22 carries for 103 yds at Oregon, with Jaivian Thomas and Anthony Woods rotating. The UCLA Week 7 OUT list is Iamaleava, S Tao Johnson (backup Ta'Shawn James has 3 INT), WR Mikey Matthews (foot surgery, season-ending), Jonah Smith and Sam Yoon (SI All Bruins). I found no Wisconsin injury report in any search; the LBs Cooper Catalano and Mason Posa are presumed to play.
3) Advanced/stats: There is no in-season SP+ in my results. Preseason SP+ had UCLA 46th (+5.1) and WIS 61st (+1.8), and one preview says SP+ and FPI had UCLA by about 3 before the injury. ESPN: WIS scores 31.6 ppg and allows 16.6; UCLA scores 39.2 and allows 18.0. FLM: WIS allows 3.2 YPC. Predictem says WIS leads the league in pass D (152.6 yds/g). UCLA's Oregon win came with Oregon committing 7 of the game's 10 turnovers (AP/NBC Sports), so its offensive efficiency against good defenses is overstated. Wisconsin went from 17 to 32 sacks in 2025 but forced only 6 takeaways (last in FBS) that year (SI All Badgers).
4) Scheme: UCLA is run-first under Chesney (253 rush yds/g) but got stuffed at Oregon (79 yds), and Wisconsin plans to stack the box and pressure the new QB (SI). UCLA's DC Colin Hitschler wins with a four-man rush (Chesney: 'didn't have to bring a whole lot more than the four'), which lets UCLA drop seven against Joseph's turnover-prone passing.
5) Coaching: Bob Chesney (Holy Cross 44-21 with 5 Patriot titles; JMU 9-4 and 12-1; now 5-0 and 5-0 ATS at UCLA) runs conservative clock-control. Luke Fickell went 4-8 in 2025 and was 1-2 straight-up after byes as of 2025 (SI), though Wisconsin is 25-12-1 after byes since 1990. I found no reliable ATS-as-dog or fourth-down data.
6) Situational: Wisconsin is off a bye (10/10) and travels west for a 4:30 PT kickoff (NBC primetime). UCLA is coming off an emotional ranked road upset and is up to No. 12 in the AP, which sets up a possible letdown with a new QB. A big Rose Bowl crowd is expected.
7) History: The two rarely meet; Wisconsin won the 1994 and 1999 Rose Bowls. UCLA is 5-0 ATS and Over 3-2. Wisconsin is 7-3 ATS and Under 7-3 in its last 10 (SI Betting). I could not confirm the most recent meeting before the search budget ran out.
8) Weather: I found no dated forecast (my searches were inconclusive). The first pass cited ESPN/AccuWeather at 89F, clear, gusts to 12 mph, cooling at night, so no weather effect is assumed.
9) Experts/market: Action Network has Feltman, Stuck, Griffith and McNamara on WIS +3/+3.5 and Ziefel (UCLA ML) and Malstrom (UCLA -3) on UCLA. Predictem has WIS +2.5. SI (Iain) has UCLA -2.5. The Sports Gambling Podcast's 3 hosts have UCLA -2.5. Dimers' model has UCLA 55.3%, 24-22 (46 total). YouWager has UCLA 28-20. ESPN FPI has UCLA 57.2%. Splits (Action Network) are about 23% of bets and 77% of money on WIS. The spread opened at 3 and is now 2.5, and the moneyline is UCLA -130/-142. The total opened at 44.5 (one book at 49.5) and is now 42.5-43.5. Model scores average about 45, slightly above the market, but I trust the QB downgrade more than models built on Iamaleava data. I hit the search budget after about 24 searches.
